I now have a complete picture. Here is my report.

## Overview

This is a Maven project (`spring-petclinic-rest`) that implements the REST endpoints two ways: a Spring MVC arm and an **OfficeFloor** arm driven by YAML "flow" files under `src/main/resources/officefloor/`. The DTOs (`OwnerDto`, `OwnerFieldsDto`, `OwnerPageDto`) are **not hand-written** — they are generated at build time by the `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` into `target/generated-sources/openapi/...`.

Important finding up front: the acceptance test expects a `displayName` field in the owner response, but **`displayName` does not exist anywhere in the codebase** except the test itself. It is not in `openapi.yml`, not in the `Owner` entity, and not computed by any function. So `AcceptanceTest.coreComputesDisplayName` currently fails against the code as-is — the feature is unimplemented.

## 1. OfficeFloor YAML for creating an owner

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`

```yaml
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireOwnerFields
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  next: rejectDuplicateTelephone

rejectDuplicateTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDuplicateTelephone
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
```

The flow chain is: `RequireOwnerFields → NormalizeOwnerTelephone → NormalizeOwnerEmail → RejectDuplicateTelephone → BuildOwner → SaveOwner → RespondWithOwnerCreated`.

Related escalation config: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation.MissingOwnerFieldsException.yml` maps `MissingOwnerFieldsException` to `MissingOwnerFieldsHandler`.

## 2. Function classes referenced by the YAML

All in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`. Contents (full source shown above in the transcript); key points:

- **`RequireOwnerFields.java`** — `service(@RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto request, Out<OwnerFieldsDto> validated)`. Reads raw body (no `@Valid`), collects blank/missing of firstName/lastName/address/city/telephone, throws `MissingOwnerFieldsException(missing)` if any, else republishes body via `validated.set(request)`.
- **`NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java`** — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request)`. Strips non-digits (`replaceAll("\\D","")`), requires exactly 10 digits else `InvalidTelephoneException`, mutates body in place.
- **`NormalizeOwnerEmail.java`** — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request)`. Optional email; blank → set null; validates against regex `^[^\s@]+@[^\s@.]+(\.[^\s@.]+)+$`; invalid → `InvalidEmailException`; valid → stored `trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)`.
- **`RejectDuplicateTelephone.java`** — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerRepository ownerRepository)`. Iterates `ownerRepository.findAll()`, compares normalized telephones, throws `DuplicateTelephoneException` (409) on collision.
- **`BuildOwner.java`** — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerMapper ownerMapper, Out<Owner> built)`. `built.set(ownerMapper.toOwner(request))`.
- **`SaveOwner.java`** — `service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository)`. `ownerRepository.save(owner)`.
- **`RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`** — `service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerMapper ownerMapper, ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<OwnerDto>> response)`. Maps to `OwnerDto` and sends `201 Created` with `Location: /api/owners/{id}` and the DTO body.

(Note: the `owner/` package has more functions — `ApplyOwner`, `LoadOwner`, `ListOwners`, `ListOwnersPage`, `DeleteOwner`, `RespondWithOwner`, `RespondWithOwnerUpdated`, `ValidateOwner`, `BuildOwnersPet`, `LoadOwnersPet` — but those are used by the GET/PUT/DELETE flows, not `owners.POST.yml`.)

## 3. Entity + DTOs

**Owner entity** — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` (extends `Person`). Fields: `address`, `city`, `telephone` (`@Pattern "^[0-9]{10}$"`), `email`, `Set<Pet> pets`. No `displayName` field. `Person` (superclass) supplies `firstName`/`lastName`/`id` — at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Person.java`.

**DTOs are generated, not source files.** There are **no** `OwnerRequest`/`OwnerResponse` classes in the repo. The equivalents are `OwnerFieldsDto` (request body) and `OwnerDto` (response), generated from `openapi.yml` into `target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/dto/`. Their shapes come from the OpenAPI schemas in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`:

- `OwnerFields` (lines 1991-2045) → `OwnerFieldsDto`: `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` (pattern `^[0-9]*$`), `email` (optional, "stored and returned lower-cased"). Required: firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone.
- `Owner` (lines 2046-2069) → `OwnerDto`: allOf `OwnerFields` plus readOnly `id` (int32) and readOnly `pets` array. **No `displayName` property.**
- `OwnerPage` (line 2070+) → `OwnerPageDto`.

To add a `displayName` in the response you would add the property to the `Owner` schema in `openapi.yml` (so it appears on `OwnerDto`) and populate it (e.g. in the mapper or `RespondWithOwnerCreated`).

**Mapper** — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` (MapStruct). Relevant: `Owner toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` (ignores id, pets) and `OwnerDto toOwnerDto(Owner)`.

## 4. Tests related to owner creation

All under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/`:

- **`AcceptanceTest.java`** — the active test. `coreComputesDisplayName()`: builds an owner node with `firstName=John`, POSTs it via `createOwnerOk`, then `getOwner(id).andExpect(jsonPath("$.displayName").value(last + ", John"))`. It asserts the response contains `displayName` = `"LastName, FirstName"`.
- **`AcceptanceBase.java`** — abstract base, `@SpringBootTest @AutoConfigureMockMvc @Transactional @WithMockUser(roles OWNER_ADMIN, VET_ADMIN, ADMIN)`. Provides helpers: `ownerNode()` (fully-valid unique payload: firstName "Test", unique lastName/address/city/telephone), `createOwner`/`createOwnerOk` (POST `/api/owners`), `getOwner`/`fetchOwner` (GET `/api/owners/{id}`), `extractId` (reads `id` from body or trailing path segment of `Location`), unique-value generators, and pinned reference data (city→region, postcodes, holidays, SHA-256/Luhn helpers) for anticipated later rules. Uses Jackson 3 (`tools.jackson.databind`).
- **`AuditLogCapture.java`** — an `AutoCloseable` test utility that attaches a Logback `ListAppender` to the `AUDIT` logger so audit side-effects can be asserted. Not owner-specific but part of the acceptance harness.

## 5. `displayName` usages in the repo

Only two, both in the test file `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` (line 7 doc comment, line 16 the `jsonPath("$.displayName")` assertion). No production code, schema, or config references `displayName`.

## 6. Build tool & running tests

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com

        - firstName
